evidence.quote: Table 6 row 9: Total investments at fair value | 5,156,571 | 4,876,989

rationale: The final Total Investments row of the March 31, 2026 Schedule of Investments reports fair value of $5,156,571 thousand. It agrees exactly with the filing balance-sheet line and the companyfacts value, so companyfacts captured the complete portfolio rather than only a non-affiliated subtotal. The total is 92.9% of total assets of $5,550,664 thousand and leaves a plausible $394,093 thousand non-investment remainder.
